patch.value: Idempotent import: --upsert keyed on bead_id marker

value.author: codex
value.text: DECISION (dedup key): Key upsert on the bead_id provenance marker the round-trip already uses ([bead_id: <id>] in description), NOT on tags. Rationale: SDK case-folds tags on storage (sibling dedup bug), so a tag-based key would mangle mixed-case bead ids. The description marker is case-preserving and is the same mechanism the exporter reads, so import/export/re-import stay consistent. On --upsert: build bead-id->pm-id index from existing items (decodeBeadId over list-all), update matched items, create unmatched. Items without a bead id (no --preserve-ids) cannot be keyed -> always create (documented).

value.author: codex
value.text: DECISION (dependency mapping): existing 2-pass import + 'pm update <id> --dep id=<pmId>,kind=blocked_by' verified on pm 2026.5.31 (read-back shows kind=blocked_by; deps tree edge_count=1). Issue #98 does NOT bite this id=..,kind=.. form. Upsert reuses pass-2 wiring but dedups edges via --replace-deps so re-import does not append duplicate deps.

value.author: codex
value.text: Implemented --upsert: buildBeadIndex() over readPmItems() keys existing items by decoded bead_id marker; matched -> pm update (omit --status when unchanged to avoid terminal re-close --force demand), unmatched -> pm create. Pass-2 deps use --replace-deps for upserted items so re-import is idempotent. --upsert+--no-preserve-ids rejected (USAGE). Verified: import 4 -> export -> upsert x2 keeps count 4, updated 4/0 created, direct edges stay 2 (no dup), dry-run upsert correctly previews 'update'.

patch.value: Implemented + functionally verified idempotent --upsert keyed on bead_id marker with atomic dep replacement.
